name: TroubleshootingBench
intro: TroubleshootingBench是一个用于评估模型识别和纠正生物协议中实际错误能力的基准测试。它包含一个由专家编写的湿实验室程序故障排除数据集，侧重于隐含知识和未在线发布的未受污染程序。该数据集包括52个协议，每个协议都配有三个专家编写的故障排除问题，旨在测试模型在非公开、基于经验的协议和依赖于隐性程序知识的错误上的表现。
build_method: 湿实验博士专家原创协议与简答题, 跨专家质检, 人工筛选
metric: Short-answer correctness, Expert 80th-percentile threshold, 95% bootstrap CI
intro_en: TroubleshootingBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate models' ability to identify and correct real errors in biological protocols. It includes a dataset of wet lab protocol troubleshooting cases written by experts, focusing on implicit knowledge and unpublished, uncontaminated protocols. The dataset contains 52 protocols, each paired with three expert-crafted troubleshooting questions, aimed at testing model performance on non-public, experience-based protocols and errors relying on implicit procedural knowledge.
metric_en: Short-answer correctness, Expert 80th-percentile threshold, 95% bootstrap CI

drawio_review_note: Aligned with OpenAI gpt-oss Model Safety paper Appendix A; official OpenAI Deployment Safety Hub TroubleshootingBench description. TroubleshootingBench asks PhD wet-lab experts to transcribe step-by-step biological protocols they have personally used and that are not available online; publication-inspired protocols must substantially change several steps. Each protocol lists required equipment and reagents. Experts create three short-answer questions by introducing a realistic execution error and describing the failed outcome, targeting tacit hands-on knowledge. More than 100 submitted protocols undergo cross-expert quality checking and manual filtering, leaving 52 protocols and 156 questions. Twelve independent relevant PhD experts establish a human baseline on a 52-question diamond set, and models answer the same set. The 80th-percentile expert score is used as an indicative threshold, with bootstrapped 95-percent confidence intervals in the paper.
